name: language-spinner
description: Learn a language while Claude thinks: the spinner shows a phrase in your target language with its translation, from packs you can write yourself

pack.title: Pack
pack.description: Where the phrases come from: a built-in pack (japanese) or a pack you added with /spinner add. Change it with /spinner pack NAME

display.title: Display
display.description: same-line: phrase and translation together. alternate: phrase first, then its translation

intervalSeconds.title: Alternate interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: In alternate display, how long the phrase and then the translation each stay up

rotateSeconds.title: New phrase every (seconds)
rotateSeconds.description: Switch to a different word after this many seconds of the same turn. 0 keeps one phrase per turn

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: What goes between phrase and translation in same-line display
